title: Completed compact-support projection construction data
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each scheme $W$ use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the completed coefficient ring sheaf $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and the ordinary derived category of its modules. A tensor model on $W$ is the existing representative-normalized signed K-flat model of the ordinary derived tensor over $R_W$; completion $\widehat{(-)}$ has its prescribed positive-quotient Roos unit $\eta$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ with a supplied compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{p_c}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], use the actual ordinary pullback $f^*$, proper/open image $P^c=Rp_{c*}j_!$, and the ordinary proper-counit/open projection $\pi^o$ [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For ordinary derived objects $M$ on $X$ and $K$ on $Y$ define
$$A^o_c(M,K)=P^cM\otimes^LK,\quad B^o_f(M,K)=M\otimes^Lf^*K,$$
$$A^c_c(M,K)=\widehat{A^o_c(M,K)},\quad B^c_c(M,K)=P^c\widehat{B^o_f(M,K)}.$$
These definitions apply to arbitrary such $f,c,M,K$ and supplied tensor models. For the integral construction fix also the finite-field datum $D$ with $k$ of characteristic $p$ and $\ell\ne p$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; no separatedness of the structural maps is required. For $M,K$ in the actual integral complete bounded constructible full categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], retain the typing helper that $\eta_{A^o_c(M,K)}$ is invertible and $A^c_c(M,K),B^c_c(M,K)$ belong to the integral constructible category. Define the integral projection between these two objects of that full category by the actual composite
$$\pi^c_{M,K}=P^c(\eta_{B^o_f(M,K)})\circ\pi^o_{M,K}\circ\eta_{A^o_c(M,K)}^{-1}.$$
The helper supplies precisely the source-unit inverse and endpoint membership used by this construction. The ordinary tensor models, all four endpoints, helper, and integral map are the existing published data, re-exported with every binder unchanged; no projection-formula invertibility conclusion is part of this definition.
